title: Stop Paying Twice: Connect Zoho CRM and Zoho Books #Shorts
description:
Optiven, a Kenyan real-estate firm, says moving its teams onto one Zoho One stack cut its software costs by 40% (the company's own figure, TV47, 11 Nov 2026). One place to start: stop running separate CRM and accounting tools. If you use Zoho CRM and Zoho Books, connect them natively so sales and finance share one customer record.

1. In Zoho Books, go to Settings › Integrations & Marketplace › Zoho Apps and connect Zoho CRM.
2. Choose what syncs: CRM accounts and contacts to Books customers, CRM products to Books items.
3. Save. Your sales team can now create estimates and invoices from inside a CRM deal, and they sync to Zoho Books.

Your savings depend on which tools you replace.

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation
